en: Color postcard showing the interior of a historic tavern or restaurant filled with rustic wooden tables, benches, and carved chairs. The walls and ceiling are heavily decorated with old weapons, armor pieces, helmets, lanterns, tools, and various curiosities. Stained‑glass windows and a framed mirror are visible on the right. At the bottom right there is a printed caption in German describing the place and its construction date.
